config.data_authority: A9-F staged basis observables, staged_basis_manifest.json (manifest sha256 3867bdca3162f219d9a62b30b6768997f89a751b7bb86231b1c1175a6e25ee88); per-file SHA-256 verified at load, fail-closed on mismatch
config.decision_clock: weekly, every Monday 00:00:00Z; 52 scheduled Mondays in the blind-S0 screen window 2025-08-22..2026-08-21 (first 2025-08-25), 51 effective after the 1-day purge (2026-04-20 in the F1 trailing purge zone); one declared execution lag
config.drop_one_pin: drop-one identifies the EARLIEST fold-stamp carrying the largest held |weight| across the whole arm schedule (chronological tie-break across stamps; under the equal-weight book all legs at one stamp tie, so the stamp-level choice is outcome-free); at that stamp it drops the single HELD leg with the LARGEST |b_i(T)| -- the most extreme premium expression, the strongest mechanism instantiation (exact |b_i| ties break by lexicographically smallest symbol id ascending; an unheld symbol can never be selected, non-vacuousness L-V11-7).  Renormalization (proposal section 8, literal text): the remaining 2k-1 held legs KEEP their sides and are renormalized to gross 1.0 as equal legs at 1/(2k-1) each; the middle tercile stays flat and the benchmark is never held.  The family survives only if the anchor's fold-sign pattern and the control rule's outcome are unchanged.
config.fill_rule: fills at the close of the first completed 15m bar strictly after the decision stamp (Monday 00:15:00Z close); stress +1 event delay fills at the Monday 00:30:00Z close
config.folds_contract: chronological F0/F1/F2 force-flat per the frozen V12 fold contract (F0 2025-08-22..2025-12-21, F1 2025-12-22..2026-04-21, F2 2026-04-22..2026-08-21) with the 1-day purge as the trailing calendar zone of each fold (V11-lineage purge_fold_members convention, the reading measured at 51 effective Mondays 17/17/17 by both the V13 implementation and A9-F; A9F-OBS-4 recorded); exactly one stamp (2026-04-20) is purged
config.lag_convention: a period bucket covering [t_open, t_open+15m) is available at its close t_close = t_open+15m (conservative bar-close availability class); a decision at T uses ONLY fully-closed prior buckets with t_close <= T; the last admissible bucket for a Monday 00:00Z stamp is [Sun 23:45, Mon 00:00); no partial bucket is ever read
config.price_only_failure_clause: price-only expectancy <= 0 while total expectancy is positive only through native funding credits => the mechanism is a carry harvest, not a price-unwind mechanism; family REJECTED as declared ex ante (proposal sections 2(e)/9; V6 adjacency).  The price-only / total split is computed by the scored layer and applied by research.v14.families.basislv_premfade.gate_runner; it is never computed in this package.
config.side_rule: long = floor(n_eligible/3) lowest premium (low/discount tier), short = floor(n_eligible/3) highest premium (high/premium tier), equal weight 1/(2*floor(n_eligible/3)), gross 1.0, middle flat, ranks ascend by (b_i, symbol id), min 12 eligible names, max |w| = 0.125 <= 0.30
config.signal_evaluation: b_i(T) = mean of p_b over the trailing N completed 15m buckets; p_b = (futuresPrice_b - indexPrice_b) / indexPrice_b (basis route)
config.signal_inputs_out_of_scope: premiumIndexKlines / markPriceKlines / indexPriceKlines / open interest / funding rate are declared out of scope for the signal (proposal section 10); funding enters ONLY as an identical native settlement cost, never a signal input
config.signal_route: /futures/data/basis contractType=PERPETUAL period=15m pair=<SYM>; fields futuresPrice/indexPrice (+ basis/basisRate identity cross-check)
